title: Checks Before the Rules
summary: Missing signatures, gas settings and broken calldata are refused before any rule is read.
lesson: Some checks come before the rules. The Safe needs its owner signatures, and the guard refuses a gas price or gas limit other than zero, and calldata too short to name a function. A catch-all that allows everything does not change that.

rules.note: Allows every CALL, so only the earlier checks can refuse

steps.label: Only Alice signs
steps.note: The Safe needs two of its three owners. It refuses before the guard is even asked.

steps.label: Ask for a gas refund
steps.note: A gas refund pays someone out of the Safe, and no policy sees that payment. The guard refuses any gas price other than zero.

steps.label: Set a gas limit for the call
steps.note: With its own gas limit set, a call that fails could still count as done. The guard requires zero, so a failure always undoes everything.

steps.label: Send three bytes of calldata
steps.note: A function is named by four bytes. With one to three bytes there is nothing to look up, so the guard refuses outright.
